program.name: convert2blastmask
program.description: Convert masking information in lower-case masked FASTA input to file formats suitable for makeblastdb

key.name: masking_algorithm
key.description: Masking algorithm name (e.g.: dust, seg, windowmasker, repeat). Use 'other' for user-defined type

key.name: masking_options
key.description: Masking algorithm options to create the masked input (free text to describe/include (command line) options used to create the masking)

flag.name: h
flag.description: Print USAGE and DESCRIPTION; ignore all other parameters

flag.name: help
flag.description: Print USAGE, DESCRIPTION and ARGUMENTS; ignore all other parameters

flag.name: version
flag.description: Print version number; ignore other arguments
